A braided woman and a blonde woman share a side hug; two companions sit together on a stone bench. Two short dresses carry red, green, blue and gold Eritrea-inspired flag motifs. Copper, midnight-blue and ruby garments, rainbow knee-high gradients and colorful heels complete the outfits. A small heart-and-window tattoo is visible on the blonde woman's upper arm.

AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women gathered on cushioned seats in an arched coastal lounge. A braided woman in turquoise leans toward a seated blonde woman in coral. A pearl-and-cobalt-clad companion crouches beside them, while another in cobalt rests a hand on her shoulder. Scorpion and agency tattoos, star-marked hosiery and rainbow platforms are visible. Distant fires and smoke across the water are imaginary scenery, not a real event.

AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women in a city-window lounge. A braided woman in a red-and-blue flag-inspired mini and a blonde woman in ice blue and graphite share a side hug. Two companions in charcoal with ruby lines and sapphire with silver piping sit together, with a gentle shoulder touch. A RAZE upper-arm tattoo is visible. The fictional city and hillside backdrop is calm.

AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women in a cushioned valley-view lounge. A braided woman in emerald reclines with her head beside a blonde companion in ivory and copper. A woman in jade and a sand-colored skort crouches nearby; a fourth in deep teal rests a hand on her shoulder from a higher seat. Crescent and star-like tattoos and varied green footwear are visible. The calm river-and-steppe background is fictional, with no disaster effects.
